text:
clare: Quick thread for a small post-launch "spark" drip. Goal: 3 short emails over 7 days to onboard signups -> webinar opt-in -> trial. Keep things snappy and code-forward for devs.

josh: Nice. Proposed segments: dev_docs_clicks, newsletter_only, enterprise_ops. We'll flag enterprise by company domain + size > 40.

kim: cadence idea: S1 (welcome + 2 bullets, immediate), S2 (mini case + 1 metric, day 3), S3 (invite to a 30-min benchmark walkthrough, day 7).

leo: subject line options S1: "You're in — here's one quick thing to try" vs "Welcome — start with this 30s test". Run A/B on dev_docs_clicks only.

clare: creative: tiny animated GIF of the console for S1 (loop, <90KB). S2 include a compact PNG showing cost per 1k tokens vs baseline (small alt text). S3 include calendar link for the webinar.

josh: include a micro-curl in S2 for dev segment: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
``` keep it inline and short.

kim: tracking: open, click, webinar_reg, trial_start. UTMs: utm_campaign=spark_drip_launch, utm_content={segment}. Also tag with mail_variant for subject tests.

leo: send windows: dev_docs_clicks Tue 9am PT, newsletter_only Wed 2pm PT, enterprise_ops Mon 11am PT. For enterprise, surface enterprise calendar link `https://cal.redwood.ai/enterprise` with utm_medium=email.

clare: owners: josh = segment export + suppressions, kim = copy + subject tests, leo = send ops (Braze), me = creative assets.

josh: export CSV with columns: email,segment,company,company_size,intent_score,signup_ts,exclude_flag. ETA tomorrow 10am to #marketing-assets.

kim: suppression rules: remove anyone with unsubscribe flag or bounced in last 180 days, and drop internal domains. Also exclude any who attended last week's webinar.

marketing-bot: reminder set: draft copy due Thu EOD, assets due Mon 9am. :spiral_calendar:

leo: rollout plan: Phase A = dev_docs_clicks (~3k). Send S1 -> measure opens for 24h. If open < 12% swap subject then resend. If click >= 4% proceed. After 48h expand to newsletter_only.

clare: design constraints: max 1 image each email, total email size <120KB, include plain-text fallback. Use accessible alt text.

josh: measurement cohorts: create cohort spark_drip_launch_dev to track funnel email -> webinar_reg -> trial within 14 days.

kim: copy constraints: S1 body <110 words with single CTA button. S2 include a 1-sentence customer quote. S3 should include the webinar date/time + option to book a 1:1 for enterprise leads.

leo: add guardrail: if intent_score > 85 for a recipient, surface CTA to book an immediate demo instead of webinar. Use param ?utm_content=high_intent.

josh: I'll attach suppression list when I drop CSV. Also will exclude trialers who already started.

clare: quick check: calendar links use utm_medium=email and utm_campaign above. Good to go?

kim: yes, I'll post draft copy here by Wed noon.

marketing-bot: Note: campaign will auto-pause if bounce rate > 5% or complaint rate > 0.1%.
